name: Apps
title: Apps: the apps Rouh builds and runs for you, on an apps server of your own

permissions: checks each of the owner's apps by its address every five minutes
makes a one-line setup that turns a server the owner bought into an apps server; Rouh never buys one
with a Hostinger API token the owner pasted, lists their VPSs and sets up one they pick: a new one, or with its name typed back, an installed one, which it wipes
queues commands from a closed list (set up, deploy, update, roll back, restart, logs, back up, test restore) that the owner's apps server takes when it calls in
jobs: the check of every app by its address, every five minutes (rouh/apps_hosting.py watch_loop)
touches.remove: Delete rouh/apps_hosting.py, rouh/web/apps_hosting.py, rouh/models/apps.py, appspage.*, deploy/apps-server/, the apps tool, its lines in urls.py, gate.py, runtime.py, address.js, runs.js, cards.js and index.html, and this manifest; a migration drops the four tables. The apps servers keep running and their apps with them.
